beta.changelog: * New: Noxpress Core 1.2.0 adds Install all, Update all and Uninstall all to the Noxpress hub. Each opens a checklist to confirm and then works one plugin at a time through WordPress's own installer, with the usual sha256 and signature check. Install all follows the update channel and does not activate unless ticked; Uninstall all deactivates and deletes (each plugin's own uninstall runs), needs a typed word, and leaves Site Bridge and Data Migrator unticked by default.

Install all follows the update channel and does not activate unless ticked; Uninstall all deactivates and deletes (each plugin's own uninstall runs), needs a typed word, and leaves Site Bridge and Data Migrator unticked by default.

* Optional backup encryption (beta), off by default: AES-256 (WinZip AE-2), readable by 7-Zip, WinZip and macOS, with a password stored sealed or set in wp-config.php (`NM_BACKUP_PASSWORD`), and a password generator.
* Encrypted backups in the analysis, the restore, the installer and WP-CLI (`--password`); uploaded encrypted backups register without the password.
* `wp data-migrator list` shows whether a backup is encrypted.
* Fix: the requests CSV passes every fputcsv() argument, so PHP 8.4 prints no deprecation notice into the file.

* Fix: a page lives at most 12 hours in the cache. The 24 h, 48 h and "until the next purge" choices are gone (a saved one becomes 12 h): WordPress nonces in older pages stopped forms and buttons from working.
* Fix: a site whose drop-in names another copy of the plugin (a staging copy, a moved site, a symlinked plugins folder) no longer stops with "Cannot declare class FPG_Key". The drop-in now loads the plugin from the site's own plugins folder first, and a 1.0.0 drop-in is rewritten on update.
* Fix: no PHP 8.4 deprecation notice for an implicitly nullable parameter (FPG_Files).
* New: the Author Portal cookie of Revenue Splitter (rs_ptok) means "personal page", like a login. Other plugins add their own session cookies with the filter noxpress_private_cookies.

* New: weekly schedule. Online by itself on the days and hours you choose (up to 3 windows a day, in the site's time zone, also past midnight), with closed dates for holidays. «Go offline» inside a window pauses it until its end, and the next window opens as usual; «Go online» outside it works as before. A notification when a window starts (optional, on by default) and when it ends. Set it in Noxpress › Live Operator or from the app («Schedule»); the Android app shows it without a new version. Off by default.
* The availability is worked out on every check, so it is right even when WP-Cron runs late; one WP-Cron event at the next change only sends the notifications.

* Fix: the limit per IP address reads REMOTE_ADDR, and CF-Connecting-IP only when the request comes from Cloudflare. Headers such as X-Forwarded-For, which any visitor can send, are no longer used, so the limit cannot be bypassed by changing them.
